detail.seen: First seen {{first}}, last seen {{last}} · {{items}} items · {{boms}} BOMs

types.BOM_LINE_KEY_MISSING: A BOM line has no parent or child item number.
types.BOM_DATE_UNRESOLVED: Valid-from or valid-till date cannot be read; the line stays in scope until fixed.
types.PSEUDO_FLAG_UNKNOWN: The phantom flag (STFIST) has a value that is not configured.
types.BOM_QUANTITY_UNPARSEABLE: The BOM quantity (STMNG) is not a number.
types.ITEM_TYPE_UNKNOWN: The item has no GSAR00 base record (ARMONR blank) or its ARVAKZ code is not supported.
types.ITEM_MODEL_AMBIGUOUS: GSAR00 has several base records (ARMONR blank) with different ARVAKZ values; no row is chosen.
types.BOM_CHILD_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The child model (STMNRU) does not exist for the item in GSAR00.
types.BOM_LINE_KEY_NOT_UNIQUE: Parent, BOM type and position occur on several lines (information only).
types.BOM_CYCLE: The BOM contains a loop through this parent-child link.
types.MAPPING_MISSING: An engineering mapping has no target attribute or value.
types.MAPPING_PENDING_REVIEW: The mapping is predicted or marked for review and is not used until confirmed.
types.ATTRIBUTE_NOT_IN_BS: The target attribute is not a Bluestar class variable.
types.VALUES_NOT_IN_VALUELIST: Mapped values are missing in the Bluestar value list.
types.VALUES_INVALID_FOR_TYPE: Mapped values are not valid for the variable's value type (e.g. text in a number).
types.INHERITED_ATTRIBUTE_MISSING_ON_TOP_ITEM: A child needs the attribute from its parents, but no parent up to the top item defines it.
types.INHERITED_DEFINITION_CONFLICT: Parents define the inherited attribute with different global variables or value lists.
types.FIXED_TO_CONFIGURABLE: A Swing FIXED item inherits attributes and becomes CONFIGURABLE; an Approver must decide.
types.ITEM_NOT_APPROVED_FOR_MIGRATION: The item is not approved for migration in the Migration Tool.
types.MT_ITEM_HEADER_MISSING: The item has mappings but no Migration Tool item header.
